Surprisingly decent pizza in Saigon
Feb 2025 • Solo
I visited the Jimmy's location in District 1, not far from Ben Thanh Market. I had the individual peperoni pizza with extra cheese. Being from New York, I am very critical of pizza, especially those advertised as "New York" pizza. I was favorably impressed. I tend to avoid Pizza in Asia, since most Asian cultures don't understand or appreciate cheese. A friend took me to a "Western style" restaurant up near Chu Lai. I ordered the sausage pizza, and discovered that they didn't think pizza needed any tomato sauce, and their idea of "sausage" was sliced hot dog. So, at Jimmy's, Sauce 10/10; Cheese Quality 10/10; Peperoni 10/10; Crust 9/10. A nice surprise in Saigon.

reviews.review_text:
Leean W

One of the Ver7 Best Pizza Restaurants in Town
Aug 2022
In Ho Chi Minh we are really spoiled for choice as far as excellent pizzas are concerned and yet I would still place Jimmy's New York Pizza in the top 3 restaurants to have a pizza. It would be difficult to place Jimmy's in first, second or third place so I honestly believe that the restaurant would have to receive a tie with 2 others in first position - such is the delicious experience of their pizzas! There are 2 branches, one is delivery only in District 2, whereas in District 7 we are fortunate enough to have their bright, cheery New York style diner. The staff are particularly friendly and ultra helpful and the owner and managers are very welcoming. But it is the pizza that draws me and friends back time and time again. The base has a crispness as well as a softness to it which is really difficult to explain but the description will be recognised as soon as someone bites into it. For me, this is the best base in the city - the texture and the taste. Only too often pizzas can have a soggy base, or are too thin and crispy like a cheese cracker even. But never at Jimmy's . Here is is perfect with absolutely mouthwatering toppings. The tomato and cheese bases are always piping hot and have that freshly cooked taste, and the ham and bacon is delicious on the Hawaiian pizza, as is the generous fresh pineapple. Occasionally I will also customise my veggie pizza and the staff are super willing and happy to do this. So, not particularly liking olives on my pizza, I often ask if tomatoes can be exchanged for the olives and when the pizza arrives it is sheer bliss to bite into that cheesy, tomato pizza with green peppers, onions and well cooked generous cherry tomato halves on it. The staff always provide freshly chopped chilies on the side as they know I enjoy putting my own fresh chilies on my pizzas. Our friend adores their pepperoni pizza and often has half a pepperoni pizza with half of a different pizza, to work her way through all of the pizzas. Jimmy's is very welcoming of mixing and matching pizzas for you. She adores their blue cheese sauce with the salad too but I much prefer their extremely tasty french dressing made with balsamic dressing. If I have one minor criticism at all it is that there is way too much salad dressing for me on the salad but that is easily remedied. After the first time, I asked if the salad dressing could be served separately on the side which was readily agreed to, and the waitstaff have done this ever since. They are super attentive with excellent memories and care to get everything perfect for each customer. A quick mention must also be made of the accompanying salad and french fries. The salad is crisp and fresh, made up of generous iceberg leaves, cherry tomatoes, cucumber and crispy onions (grated carrots too if needed) and the crinkly cut medium thickness french fries are one of the best of 2 places in the city that serve the tastiest, most wonderful textured fries. As final tribute to Jimmy's, my husband who has never been fond of pizza, discovered Jimmy's at the age of 83 and is now a weekly fan same as me and many of our friends. He also very much enjoys their boneless wings - far more meat on these than spindly wings - eaten with either their ranch or buffalo sauce. This is truly a wonderful gastronomic experience with great tasting wine at an exceptionally good price.
